**Which model / entry?**
Name or id from the Model guide (e.g. `kimi-k3`).

**What is wrong or missing?**
Current value shown by WhichAI vs the correct value.

**Official source (required)**
Link to the vendor page, model card, pricing page or recognized benchmark. Corrections without a source cannot be applied.
